headline: Exercise Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Log exercise type, activity, duration, and intensity to build a consistent fitness routine and track your physical health progress.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Log exercise type and specific activity
Record session duration and intensity level
View weekly exercise summaries and stats
Track consistency and progress over time
tips: Log workouts immediately after completing them while details are still fresh.
Vary intensity levels and track the mix to ensure a balanced fitness routine.
